title: 港股8月行情开门红！恒指突破26000点再创反弹新高，科网股全线大涨
summary: 8月3日，港股全面走强，恒指突破26000点再创反弹新高，科网股普涨。阿里巴巴涨超6%、腾讯涨超3%、百度涨超2%；AI股小幅分化，光伏股活跃，存储概念延续走弱。全球资金再平衡带动港股科技估值修复。
why: 持仓阿里巴巴(9988)、腾讯(0700)今日均大幅上涨，做多方向顺风；注意短期波动率是否已收缩至适合covered call的区间

title: 香港交易所5年期中国国债期货今日正式推出，境外投资者获利率风险管理新工具
summary: 港交所于8月3日推出5年期人民币国债期货，境外机构可藉此对冲约2万亿元人民币国债的利率风险，进一步巩固香港离岸人民币枢纽地位，扩大国际投资者在离岸市场的风险管理工具箱。
why: 新衍生品丰富港市生态，有助于境外资金更积极配置人民币资产，间接利好港股整体估值与流动性环境

title: 港交所下调证券最低上落价位第二阶段今日实施，流动性有望进一步改善
summary: 香港联合交易所8月3日实施下调最低上落价位第二阶段安排，进一步缩小低价股的最小报价单位，旨在提升相关股份的交投活跃度、降低买卖差价，改善整体市场流动性。
why: 制度改善利好港股流动性整体提升，对低价港股标的交易成本有所下降，有助于市场深度改善

title: Big Earnings Week: Palantir (PLTR) Tonight, AMD Tuesday, Disney+SanDisk (SNDK) Wednesday; July Jobs Report Friday
summary: Key events for the Aug 3-7 week: Palantir Q2 results after today's close (consensus: ~$1.81B rev, +80% YoY); AMD Q2 Tuesday ($11.3B expected); Walt Disney Q3 FY26 and SanDisk full-year FY26 on Wednesday; Tencent Q2 on Aug 12. Friday's July nonfarm payrolls is the macro anchor — June printed a weak +57K vs. +115K expected, raising September rate-cut odds.
why: Palantir/SanDisk直接持仓，本周业绩是期权策略的关键触发点；非农决定Fed 9月降息预期，影响整体估值水位；Tencent Aug 12业绩也需提前布局

title: 美国Q2 GDP初值年化+1.5%，大幅低于预期+2.1%，增速放缓强化9月降息预期
summary: 美国商务部经济分析局(BEA)7月30日公布，Q2 GDP年化增速初值为+1.5%，低于市场预期的+2.1%，较Q1的+2.1%明显放缓。同期PCE通胀率3.7%。GDP第二次估算将于8月26日公布，届时还将同步发布企业利润数据。
why: GDP低于预期强化9月降息预期，短期利好估值；但经济增速放缓暗示消费与企业支出趋弱——需关注持仓消费类标的的业绩指引；sell put 策略在降息预期下隐含波动率可能回落
source: 美国商务部经济分析局(BEA)

title: 阿里巴巴发布2.4万亿参数大模型Qwen3.8-Max，千问办公QwenWork同日开启公测
summary: 8月3日，阿里巴巴发布新一代旗舰基座模型Qwen3.8-Max，参数规模达2.4万亿，编程与Agent能力大幅提升，成为"两万亿参数俱乐部"最新成员。同日，企业级AI Agent平台"千问办公(QwenWork)"开启公测，整合QoderWork/MuleRun/悟空三款产品，深度绑定钉钉生态，支持桌面Agent、云Agent及企业协作Agent。
why: 双重AI产品落地是今日阿里港股涨超6%的重要催化；直接利好阿里云AI收入加速，长期看能否从模型到变现是核心；重点关注云API收入及企业采购合同数据

title: Moonshot's Kimi K3 Built on 20,000 Nvidia Chip Cluster From Alibaba; White House Alleges Export Control Breach
summary: Bloomberg reported that Moonshot AI used ~20,000 Nvidia chips (H200 accelerators) provided via Alibaba's cloud to train Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-source model. Kimi K3 outperforms Alibaba's own Qwen models on key benchmarks. White House OSTP director Michael Kratsios separately alleged Moonshot may have obtained Nvidia Blackwell chips via a Southeast Asia intermediary in breach of US export controls.
why: 延续报道：事件于7月31日由Bloomberg首发，今日(8月3日)仍是阿里港股上涨的重要驱动因素，同时触发中美芯片出口管制风险——密切关注管制升级是否殃及英伟达持仓；若白宫指控坐实，阿里作为算力提供方或面临合规压力

title: 阿里巴巴主席蔡崇信宣布离婚，声明不涉及出售任何阿里股份
summary: 8月1日，阿里巴巴集团主席蔡崇信与妻子吴明华联合宣布结束近30年婚姻。双方发表声明称，此次分手系"相互尊重"决定，且不涉及任何出售阿里巴巴股份的计划，蔡崇信将继续履行董事会主席职责。
why: 消除市场对大股东离婚可能引发减持的担忧，有利于股价稳定；需持续关注公司治理动态与大股东持仓变化

title: 老铺黄金盈喜远低于市场预期，Q2收入断崖式下滑，股价自高位累跌约73%
summary: 老铺黄金(6181.HK)公告H1 2026净利约43.1-43.6亿元（同比+83-85%），但Q2收入约33亿元较Q1大幅萎缩，远低于市场预期。7月28日股价单日跌23.76%，机构密集下调目标价：高盛至560港元、招商证券国际至304港元、中金至604港元。截至8月3日，股价已自历史高位累跌约73%。
why: 延续报道：增长神话破灭后估值重构仍在持续，今日股价仍微幅下跌；黄金赛道走势分化——金价高位回落导致黄金珠宝需求承压，持有黄金相关衍生品者需重新评估行权价

title: Palantir (PLTR) Q2 2026 Reports Tonight After Close — Consensus $1.81B Revenue (+80% YoY), 9th Straight Beat Sought
summary: Palantir reports Q2 2026 results after today's close with a 5pm ET webcast. Wall Street expects revenue of ~$1.81B (+80% YoY) and adj. EPS of ~$0.35. PLTR has beaten estimates for 8 consecutive quarters (avg. +14.6% EPS surprise). Stock has shed ~40% from its peak, trading at ~$123. Options market implies ~12% post-earnings move.
why: 直接持仓Palantir；期权方向重点：12%隐含摆幅是否合理？关注US Government vs. Commercial收入结构、AIP平台增速及全年收入指引是否调升至$7.65B以上

title: SK海力士Q2营收历史新高仍不及预期，港股存储板块持续重挫，今日南方两倍做多海力士再跌逾13%
summary: SK海力士Q2 2026营收约79.3万亿韩元（同比+257%）、HBM4进入量产，但业绩仍不及市场高预期。7月28日财报公布后，港股存储概念急挫，南方两倍做多海力士单日跌超30%；8月3日延续跌势（再跌超13%），A股科创50跌超3.7%，兆易创新等存储个股持续承压。
why: 延续报道：SK海力士杠杆ETP的连续大跌警示存储周期转折风险；若HBM增长预期进一步下修，将波及英伟达配套供应链；建议检视存储赛道敞口并评估是否需要期权对冲

title: S&P 500 and Dow Jones Hit Fresh Records on Aug 4; Nasdaq Surges 2.6% on AI Earnings Wave
summary: U.S. equities surged on August 4: S&P 500 +1.79% to 7,737 (record high), Dow Jones +1.71% to 54,085 (first-ever close above 54,000), Nasdaq +2.59% to 26,585. Gains driven by strong AI-era earnings (AMD, SpaceX) and easing oil-price fears as US-Iran deal talks progressed.
why: 美股连创历史新高是港股今晨高开的重要催化；Nasdaq大涨2.6%直接利好持仓的AI/科技方向；Dow首破54000点验证宏观多头动能延续

title: Bessent Says US-Iran Deal May Come "This Week"; WTI Oil Drops 3% as Hormuz Fears Ease
summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on August 4 that a deal to end the US-Iran conflict could come "this week," sending WTI crude down roughly 3%. Easing Strait of Hormuz supply-chain fears supported the broader equity rally, with energy stocks dragging while risk assets climbed.
why: 油价急跌直接压低通胀预期，强化美联储9月降息置信度；霍尔木兹风险溢价消退短期利好科技股估值；需关注协议落地细节与中东局势后续演变

title: Amazon Hits $3 Trillion Market Cap After Q2 Blow-Out: First $200B Quarter, AWS Revenue +37% YoY
summary: Amazon crossed the $3 trillion market-cap threshold after Q2 2026 earnings: total revenue $200.6B (+20% YoY, the first quarter exceeding $200B), AWS cloud revenue $42.2B (+37% YoY), and operating income $21.8B. The result validates continued AI infrastructure demand.
why: Amazon $3万亿里程碑改写市场情绪基调；AWS +37%增速验证AI基础设施投资逻辑，直接利好持仓英伟达（GPU供应商）；谷歌云竞争格局参考对比信号

title: 港股午盘8月5日：恒指微涨0.11%报25881点，科技指数涨1.09%，半导体板块强势
summary: 8月5日午盘，恒生指数小幅上涨0.11%至25,881点，恒生科技指数涨1.09%；黄金股板块延续强势，半导体及AI基建概念走强。整体成交量较前日有所收窄，市场等待本周多家科技巨头业绩指引及美联储信号。
why: 港股科技指数午间正增长，直接影响腾讯(0700)、阿里巴巴(9988)等核心持仓盘中表现；半导体板块走强与英伟达、SK海力士行情呼应

title: AMD Q2 2026: Revenue $11.53B (+50% YoY) Beats; Data Center +107% to $6.7B; Stock -8% AH on Margin Miss
summary: AMD reported Q2 2026 revenue of $11.53B (+50% YoY), beating consensus, with Data Center segment revenue doubling to $6.7B (+107% YoY). Adjusted gross margin of 53.1% missed the 54% consensus, and Q3 guidance of $12.5B ±$500M underwhelmed, sending shares down ~8% after hours.
why: AMD Data Center翻倍印证AI芯片需求旺盛，但毛利率承压暗示GPU市场竞争加剧；对持仓英伟达是双面信号——AI需求强劲（利好）vs 竞争格局变化（需观察H200/B200定价能力）

title: SpaceX (SPCX) First Post-IPO Earnings: Revenue $7.8B (+92%), AI Segment +247%; CapEx $18.4B Surge Sends Stock -8% AH
summary: SpaceX reported its inaugural post-IPO quarterly results: Q2 revenue $7.8B (+92% YoY), with the AI/compute segment growing +247%. Capital expenditures of $18.4B — double year-ago levels and far above the $12B Wall Street estimate — sent SPCX shares down ~8% after hours, raising questions about merger financing.
why: SpaceX超高资本支出大幅超出预期，直接增加SpaceX-特斯拉合并的融资不确定性；SpaceX AI算力板块+247%是Starlink+算力商业化路线的关键信号；影响Musk资产配置及相关股东信心

title: Palantir (PLTR) Q2 2026: Revenue $1.94B (+93% YoY), US Commercial +149%; Full-Year Raised to $8.15B; Stock +12% AH
summary: Palantir Q2 2026 revenue of $1.94B (+93% YoY) beat the $1.81B consensus; U.S. commercial revenue of $764M (+149% YoY) accelerated sharply. Adjusted EPS of $0.41 beat the $0.35 estimate. Full-year 2026 guidance raised to $8.15B from prior $7.65B. Shares rose ~12% after hours — the ninth consecutive earnings beat.
why: 直接持仓Palantir，+12%涨幅需重新评估期权策略：covered call行权价是否需上移，或转spread锁定部分溢价；US Commercial +149%验证AIP企业渗透加速，全年指引$8.15B显著超原预期

title: SK Hynix and SanDisk Jointly Unveil HBF (High Bandwidth Flash) Standard at FMS 2026: 512GB, 3TB/s
summary: At Flash Memory Summit 2026 (Aug 4), SK Hynix and SanDisk jointly announced the High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) memory standard: 512GB capacity and 3TB/s bandwidth, positioned between HBM (fast, low capacity) and conventional SSDs (high capacity, slower), targeting AI model inference pools that exceed HBM's per-stack ceiling.
why: 闪迪（SanDisk，直接持仓）联合SK海力士共同定义HBF标准，标志其从NAND存储向AI推理内存市场延伸；HBF若获英伟达下一代AI服务器平台采纳，将开辟第二增长曲线；关注FMS 2026后续OEM采购合同

title: Tesla Weighs China Business Sale Ahead of SpaceX Merger — Bloomberg/WSJ; Musk Denies; Still Developing
summary: Bloomberg and WSJ reported July 31 that Tesla is considering divesting its China manufacturing and sales unit ahead of a broader Tesla-SpaceX merger. Elon Musk denied the report on August 1. The story remains active as SpaceX's Q2 CapEx surge ($18.4B) complicates merger financing, and Tesla China supply-chain stocks (CATL, BYD components) fell 3–5%.
why: 特斯拉中国业务分拆若落地将重塑供应链体系，波及宁德时代等核心供应商；SpaceX业绩发布后合并融资压力显著增大；Musk否认仍需关注后续官方公告及中国监管反应

title: Circle (CRCL) Falls as Morgan Stanley Downgrades to $38 Target; Q2 Revenue Miss; NYDFS Charter Approved
summary: Morgan Stanley downgraded Circle Internet Financial (CRCL) on August 3, cutting the price target to $38 from $55 citing stablecoin margin compression and competition from bank-issued digital dollars. Circle's Q2 revenue missed estimates. Offsetting news: NYDFS approved a limited-purpose trust company charter on July 31; USDC holds ~62% of regulated stablecoin market share.
why: Circle（稳定币赛道持仓）Morgan Stanley降级叠加Q2 miss将加剧短期卖压；NYDFS牌照是监管合规里程碑但短期无法对冲业绩承压；关注Tether竞争是否进一步压缩USDC利差

title: Pop Mart Opens First International Pop Bakery in Singapore (July 30); Sony Pictures Labubu Film in Pre-Production; SEA Expansion Accelerates
summary: Pop Mart opened its first international Pop Bakery at Resorts World Sentosa, Singapore on July 30, offering Labubu- and Molly-themed desserts — a new IP-to-food vertical. Separately, Sony Pictures confirmed a Labubu animated feature film in pre-production as a potential global brand catalyst. The company is targeting Southeast Asia as its next high-growth revenue pillar.
why: 泡泡玛特（直接持仓）IP多元化变现加速：南洋餐饮（Pop Bakery）+ 索尼大银幕（Labubu动画）双线并行；东南亚高增长市场是下一个收入支柱，观察Q3授权+餐饮收入能否在毛利率上体现
